auth_intro: Sign in with an email code to keep your place at the table.
auth_code_hint: Eight digits. The code expires in 15 minutes.
auth_send_error: Could not send a code. Check your connection and try again.
auth_code_error: That code is invalid or has expired. Try again or request a new code.
auth_return_hint: You can close the app and return while your session remains valid.
auth_sign_out_error: Could not sign out. Please try again.
auth_identity_error: Could not verify your session. Check your connection, or sign out and try again.
games_unavailable: This game is unavailable. Sign in with the email that holds your seat.
games_saved: Your game and seat are saved. Return from any device with the same email.
games_create_error: Could not create the game. Check your connection and try again.
games_list_error: Could not load your games. Check your connection.
games_empty: No unfinished games yet. Create your first table.
invite_link_hint: Share this link. You approve each new seat before they can see the game.
invite_intro: Request a seat. The host must approve you before you can enter the game.
invite_pending: Your seat request is waiting for host approval.
invite_rejected: The host declined your seat request.
invite_unavailable: This invitation is unavailable. Ask the host for a link.
invite_error: Could not complete that request. The table may be full. Try again.
rules_base_match: Use one 36-card deck. Match suit or rank, or play a wild 6 or Jack. A Jack chooses the suit. Cover a 6 before passing. You may play several cards of one rank in your chosen order.
rules_base_draw: Draw until you can play, then play the new card immediately. A 7 makes the next player draw one and play; an 8 makes them draw two and skip. Stacked 7s and 8s add their draws. The Queen of Spades makes them draw five. Other stacks use only the top card effect. Penalties do not transfer.
rules_base_score: An empty hand ends the round after its final effect. Count held cards: 6–9 = 0; 10, Queen, King = 10; Ace = 15; Jack = 20; Queen of Spades = 50. A special King of Spades draws seven and is worth 80. Apply the recycle multiplier once, then deduct 20 for each finishing Jack. Exact cutoff resets to zero; exceeding it loses.
rules_base_start: The first starter is random and puts their last dealt card face up, keeping one fewer card. Later starters follow the selected policy. Highest score breaks ties by previous-round points, then randomly. An enabled Bridge declaration plays all four cards of one rank to end the round and scores any cards still held.
rules_hand_hint: 2 to 9 cards, so a 36-card deck fits four players.
rules_edit_hint: Applying rules clears everyone's ready status. Rules lock when the first round starts.
rules_error: Could not complete that request. Refresh and review the latest rules, then try again.
rules_reviewed: You have reviewed the current rules.
rules_waiting: Waiting for everyone to review the rules.
rules_need_players: Invite at least one more player before starting.
rules_table_ready: Everyone has reviewed the rules. The table is ready to start.
rules_locked: Rules are locked for this game.
rules_base_ace: An Ace skips the next player by default. With cancellation enabled, a targeted player may play an Ace to cancel the entire incoming draw or skip, including a stack. That Ace uses their turn.
round_start_error: Could not start. Check that everyone has reviewed the current rules, then try again.
round_load_error: Could not load the round. Check your connection and try again.
round_choose_suit: The starter must choose the Jack's active suit.
round_cover_six: The starter must cover the opening 6.
round_draw_effect: Opening effect: the next player draws {count}.
round_skip_effect: Opening effect: skip the next player.
round_effects_off: Opening card effects are off for this game.
round_private_hint: Only you can see these cards. Your hand and the table are saved between visits.
